name: loan_entity_extraction
title: Loan call entity extraction
description: Extract customer details, addresses and stated loan terms into nested JSON, with greeting and Bajaj introduction checks.
notice: Extract explicitly stated facts only, not creditworthiness or eligibility. Use only transcripts you are authorized to process; names, DOB, PAN and addresses are personal data. Regex candidates may miss unfamiliar wording. The sample is fictional.

fields.instructions: Did the agent end the call with a greeting or polite farewell?

criteria.Yes: An explicit closing greeting or farewell

fields.instructions: Did the agent explicitly introduce themselves as calling from Bajaj Finance?
Select the customer's full name, not the agent's name. The transcript may be in English or Hindi; retain the original script and do not invent a corrected spelling. Select none if it was not stated.
Select the customer's explicitly stated date of birth, not another date. Preserve the spoken date format.
Select the PAN card digits or characters explicitly stated for the customer. Do not invent missing digits.
Select the customer's explicitly stated profession or occupation.
Select the customer's employer or company name only if explicitly stated. Do not select the lender.
Select the customer's explicitly stated years of work experience, not age or loan tenure.
Select the customer's explicitly stated salary. Do not substitute business revenue or loan amounts. Select none if salary was not stated.
Select the pincode explicitly stated for the customer's current address, not their permanent address.
Select the city and state explicitly stated for the current address. Exclude the pincode. Do not infer a city from the pincode.
Select the pincode explicitly stated for the permanent address. Select none if no permanent address was stated; do not copy the current address.
Select the city and state explicitly stated for the permanent address. Select none if not stated. Do not copy the current address.
Select the final loan principal amount explicitly stated by the agent, not salary, EMI, fees or a maximum promotional offer.
Select the explicitly stated interest rate and reducing or flat basis, not a fee percentage.
Select the final loan repayment tenure, not the customer's work experience.
Select the explicitly stated monthly loan EMI amount.
Select the explicitly stated number of installments. Do not calculate it from the tenure.
Select the explicitly stated processing fee amount, not a percentage. Do not calculate it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, I am Kavya calling from Bajaj Finance. May I confirm your name and date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My name is Arjun Verma. My date of birth is 01/01/1992.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please confirm the PAN card characters requested for this fictional demo and your profession.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My PAN card digits are 64 1 G. My profession is Business.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What is your current address city and pincode?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My current address is Colonymarket, Uttar Pradesh, pincode 271502.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You have not provided a company, work experience, salary or permanent address. I will leave those blank. The final loan amount is Rs 50,000. The interest rate is 31% reducing. The loan tenure is 35 months.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Please confirm the EMI, number of installments and processing fee.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The EMI is Rs 2657. There are 35 installments. The processing fee is Rs 2127. These are the quoted terms, not a calculation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you for explaining the quoted terms.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time. Have a good day. Goodbye.
